### New in 1.2.0
- **Scan to add a book**: point the camera at the barcode and Shelfwise fills in the title, author, description and cover (Open Library, then Google Books). You can also type the ISBN.
- **EPUB books**: attach an EPUB and read it with the same paper page turns. Choose a text size, and Shelfwise remembers your place. The title, author and cover are filled in for you.
- **Bookmarks & notes**: bookmark any page, or write a note on it, and jump back from the Notes list.
- **Reading time & a yearly goal**: Shelfwise counts the time you actually spend reading. Set a goal for the year and watch the ring fill up on Home and in Stats. Rewind shows your hours, your top-rated read and your goal.
- **Star ratings** for every book, plus a "How was it?" prompt when you finish one.
- **Backups can carry your book files**: turn on Settings → Include book files to get a .zip that brings your PDFs and EPUBs along.
- **Update alerts**: Shelfwise checks for new versions and installs them for you (Settings → Updates).
- **Smoother shelves**: while you drag a book, the others slide apart to make room.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
